After Apple first introduced Liquid Glass on iOS earlier this year, WhatsApp is working to bring the design to more interface elements. Details below.

Liquid Glass is coming to the WhatsApp drawing editor and video player

If the following feels familiar, please bear with us: WhatsApp is further expanding its Liquid Glass redesign to more parts of the app.

Earlier this year, WhatsApp finally rolled out the first wave of Liquid Glass changes more broadly, after more than six months of testing.

At the time, the WhatsApp parent company was also working to bring the new design to elements like the voice message player, message reactions, and context menus, but those changes remained limited to beta versions of the app.

According to WABetaInfo, the latest WhatsApp iOS beta shows that the company is preparing to extend Liquid Glass visuals to more interface elements, including the drawing editor and the video player's progress bar.

WABetaInfo reports:

It's worth noting that some 9to5Mac readers have often said their iPhones have still not received the first wave of Liquid Glass updates; however, this news shows Meta is continuing to adopt this new visual language, extending beyond iOS to macOS and iPadOS as well.

Back to this news, WABetaInfo notes: "This feature is still under development and is not yet available to beta users."
